title: Delivery
description: Six explanations of the hidden parcel journey: detours, barcodes, boxes, the last mile, containers and returns.
deck: Between order placed and parcel delivered, a whole system gets to work.
intro: A parcel’s route can look unreasonable when you follow just one parcel. A barcode can identify a box without knowing where it is. A return can reach a warehouse without being ready for another buyer. This issue follows the journey through networks, information, space and the decisions that connect them.
labPitch: Move a hub, change a box and inspect a check digit. Three small experiments separate the arithmetic from the promises.
coverDeck: The detour on the map. The box full of space. The label that knows a number, but doesn’t know where it is.

title: Waiting
description: Six source-led explanations of queues, bus bunching, spare capacity and the experience of delay, plus the interactive Queue Lab.
deck: The world keeps you waiting. Here is a way to understand what it is doing.
intro: A queue looks like people standing still. Underneath it, work is arriving, capacity is being shared, and small irregularities are growing or shrinking. This first issue follows those movements: from the bus stop to the counter, from a useful equation to the uncertainty of an unexplained delay.
labPitch: Test spare capacity, bus spacing and shared queues with transparent, deliberately simple models.
coverDeck: The line that barely moves. The bus that comes in pairs. The busy place that gets slower when it gets busier.
plateCaption: You happen to be inside it.
